text:
rachel: Thinking about a compact quick-grant flow in the console for delegated admins. single-page modal: select principal -> choose routes (search) -> pick role preset -> preview cost & conflicts -> apply. goal: fast for demos but safe for prod.

omar: Important: routing needs persisted bindings for affinity and cache warmups. temporary tokens are fine for demos, but anything >24h should create a binding entry in the store.

liu: API idea: POST /console/grants/validate (dry_run=true) that returns per-route result {route, allowed, estimated_tokens/mo, note}. call this from Preview step. keep response compact to avoid client slowness.

eng-sre-bot: FYI: when bindings change, we trigger routing-cache invalidation stream. plan to make invalidation eventual but <30s. watch for spike.

sec: Security constraints: every apply must emit an audit event (actor, org, reason). require 2FA for org_admin confirm in prod. disallow wildcard grants like /v1/* by default. cross-tenant grants need approval.

rachel: UX: in preview show small "cost impact" bar + badge: "telemetry: on/off" and a tiny explanation icon. also show a diff vs current effective permissions (+/-).

omar: Implementation note: validate needs to compute effective privileges by merging role templates, tenant overrides, and route flags. cache merged templates for 10s to keep preview snappy.

liu: Dry-run response should include a preview_id so support can reproduce the exact preview snapshot. also include conflict codes for each denied route (e.g., PARENT_POLICY, BILLING_BLOCK).

sec: Also record preview_id in audit so we can tie apply -> preview. retention policy must be >= 1yr for these artifacts.

rachel: Rollout plan: behind org-level flag. start internal -> pilot 5 customers -> 25% -> GA. telemetry events: quickgrant_open, quickgrant_preview, quickgrant_apply, quickgrant_error. tag events with mode=temp|bind, has_conflicts, preview_id.

omar: For binding apply we'll update routing index and emit a small metric gauge per-tenant. plan a canary push to avoid thundering herd on invalidation.

liu: I'll open RFC for /console/grants/validate and a companion POST /console/grants/apply (supports dry_run). will include sample payloads and error codes.

sec: I'll draft approval matrix and exceptions for wildcard routes.

rachel: Great. Action items: liu RFC, omar invalidation plan, sec approval docs, UX mock for compact modal. sync Thu. :thumbsup:
